title: Statistics & Operational Data
text:
Statistics & Operational Data
Euronext Securities Milan provides Clients with information supporting their day to day ordinary operations.
Data and statistics are available to monitor the efficiency of the CSD and it is also possible to download the main industry questionnaires used by financial institutions.
Contact our Sales Team for more information.
